The neurologist Maiken Nedergaard’s “glymphatic hypothesis” proposes that cerebrospinal fluid helps drain waste from the brain during sleep. Her evidence is highly debated.
Adam Fenster, University of Rochester
Scientists have known for more than a century that,
at the moment of death
, CSF flows from the spine into the brain. This suggests that the living brain somehow keeps the stuff moving, but no one knows exactly how or where it flows. Any arrows drawn on diagrams of the brain and skull to show its movement should not be taken as the complete truth.
“Everyone accepts that there must be some kind of flow here,” said
Christer Betsholtz
, a professor of vascular biology at the Karolinska Institute in Sweden. “About half a liter of CSF is produced in the ventricles every day, and it has to get out. People are still fighting about where the cerebrospinal fluid gets out.”
Also under discussion is whether it picks up waste on the way out of the brain and, crucially, how. There is good evidence that small molecules, at least, can diffuse through the spaces between cells, make their way to the CSF, and
ride it out of the brain
. In fact, some researchers believe that the entire system works by way of passive diffusion.

data.author: curmudgeon22
data.article_summary: Edera Protect 1.0推出了其容器安全平台，并开源了低层容器运行时Styrolite。该工具旨在为现代云原生计算和基于虚拟化的安全技术之间搭建桥梁。Styrolite作为一个微服务运行，提供丰富的编程接口，解决了现有工具如Kubernetes CRI、Bubblewrap和util-linux的unshare要么过于复杂、要么功能有限的问题。Styrolite简化了容器创建和管理过程，支持通过Rust API精确操控Linux的多种命名空间（如Mount、PID、IPC、User等），同时保留了CLI的快速迭代能力。这使得容器运行更加灵活和安全，特别适用于需要高精度控制的场景。

43486997.article_content:
Edera Protect 1.0 is now generally available. See it live at KubeCon
Product
Introducing Styrolite: Building a Linux Container Runtime from Scratch
March 26, 2025
Edera Protect is a suite of offerings bridging the gap between modern cloud native computing and virtualization-based security techniques. To power this platform, we've built our own container runtime designed to operate as a microservice, allowing it to run containers in a fully programmatic wayâsimilar to how the Kubernetes Container Runtime Interface (CRI) enables container management through microservices.
Today, we're excited to announce that we're open sourcing our
programmatic low-level container runtime, Styrolite
, so that others may benefit from our work.
Why build a new low-level container runtime?
The idea of separating the low-level container runtime concerns into its own tool or microservice is not new. Outside of the Kubernetes CRI, which presents container lifecycle management as a pluggable microservice, there are simpler tools which provide a low-level container runtime as well, such as the unshare utility in util-linux, as well as another tool called Bubblewrap.
But these tools are either too high-level (like the Kubernetes CRI), or they are designed to be used via shell scripting: Bubblewrap has a high amount of configurability, but is only accessible via a very complicated CLI that is easy to get wrong, while util-linuxâs unshare has basic functionality, but also locked behind a CLI. While CLIs allow for rapid iteration, we needed something different for Edera Protect: a rich programmatic interface for spawning and managing containers with precision. Styrolite provides the best of both worldsâa clean API directly usable from Rust, while preserving the rapid iteration capabilities of a CLI.
How Styrolite Works: Linux Containers Under the Hood
Importantly, we designed Styrolite with full awareness that Linux namespaces were never intended as hard security boundariesâa fact that explains why container escape vulnerabilities continue to emerge. Our approach acknowledges these limitations while providing a more robust foundation.
Containers in Linux â as opposed to
other
containerization
efforts
elsewhere
â are built on
Linux namespaces
. A namespace in Linux allows for an alternative view of a given type of resource, for example: the mount namespace allows for an alternative view of the mount table, and thus an alternative view of the root filesystem, while the PID namespace allows for an alternative view of the system process set. Container runtimes compose these namespaces to provide containerized environments, allowing for great flexibility at the cost of higher complexity.
At the root of all container runtimes is the
Linux unshare(2) syscall
.Â  This allows for a currently running process to dissociate from one or more of its current namespaces into a forked version of the namespace that can be modified.Â  In general, container runtimes unshare most namespaces by default because it is necessary to do:
Mount namespaces are unshared from the host so that we can pivot into a modifiable copy of a container image as the containerâs root filesystem.
PID namespaces are unshared from the host so that the containerized workload cannot view processes outside of the container.
IPC namespaces are unshared from the host so that the containerized workload cannot view or manipulate System V IPC resources unrelated to the containerized workload.
User namespaces are unshared from the host so that UIDs and GIDs inside the container are remapped to safer UIDs and GIDs in the host namespace.Â  In other words, root inside a container when running in a user namespace is usually running as an unprivileged UID outside the container environment.
Time namespaces may be unshared from the host to modify the visible system uptime.
UTS namespaces may be unshared from the host to change the visible system hostname.
Network namespaces may be unshared from the host to force the containerized workload to use an alternate networking path.
On the Edera Protect platform, all of these namespaces are unshared at different levels in the stack.Â  Styrolite when used inside the Edera Protect platform is primarily responsible for dealing with the Mount, PID, IPC, User, Time and UTS namespaces, while networking is handled elsewhere in the platform.
Simple, Programmatic Interface
Here's a glimpse of how Styrolite simplifies container creation compared to traditional approaches:
// Create a basic container with Styrolite
let
mut request = CreateRequestBuilder::
new
()
.with_rootfs(
"/path/to/container/rootfs"
)
.set_executable(â/bin/shâ)
.set_arguments(vec![â-iâ])
.set_working_directory(â/â)
.push_namespace(Namespace::User)
.push_namespace(Namespace::Mount)
.push_namespace(Namespace::Pid)
.to_request();
// Launch a process in the container
let
runner = Runner::
new
(âstyroliteâ);
runner.run(request)?;

data.title: NotaGen: Symbolic Music Generation
data.author: explosion-s
data.article_summary: 《NotaGen：结合大型语言模型训练范式提升符号音乐生成质量》一文介绍了NotaGen，一个旨在生成高质量古典乐谱的符号音乐生成模型。受大型语言模型（LLM）成功启发，NotaGen采用预训练、微调和强化学习范式。模型预训练使用了160万首音乐作品，随后在约9000首高质量古典音乐上微调，并引入CLaMP-DPO方法增强生成质量和可控性，无需人工标注。NotaGen使用Tunesformer架构和分层解码器，通过分段处理和字符预测生成音乐。实验表明，CLaMP-DPO有效提升了多种音乐生成模型的音乐性和可控性，主观测试显示NotaGen在生成质量上优于基线模型。文章还澄清了ABC符号的多功能性，展示其在多轨音乐和复杂乐谱表示中的能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成音乐的质量、与人类创作音乐的比较、AI在音乐创作中的应用潜力及局限

不同观点：
• **AI生成音乐与普通人类作曲的比较**：zoogeny认为AI生成的音乐与YouTube上一个频道中播放的普通浪漫主义时期作曲家的作品质量相当，且普通人难以区分。但他也指出，AI音乐与大师级作品仍有明显差距。

• **AI生成音乐的质量与艺术性**：
  - jcpst将AI生成的音乐比作LLM生成的文本，认为虽然音乐结构和动机发展尚可，但存在一些“人工痕迹”，类似于文本生成中的固定表达。
  - jnwatson认为AI音乐比以前的尝试好，但仍不够好，虽然基本音乐结构存在，但整体质量不高，只能在作曲课上勉强及格。
  - dimatura则认为AI生成的流行音乐虽然有些陈词滥调，但仍有不错的部分，例如中间的吉他独奏。

• **AI生成音乐的潜在问题与局限**：
  - TaupeRanger指出，AI生成的音乐即使是精选例子也很无聊，且由于训练数据主要来自古典音乐，生成音乐难以适用于现代音乐风格，特别是流行音乐。
  - yapyap认为AI生成音乐的问题在于缺乏真正的艺术视野，只是对旧音乐的重新组合，且只对那些对AI技术过度 hype 的人有吸引力。

• **AI在音乐创作中的工具性作用**：
  - Rochus提供了一个在线服务链接，供人们直接收听AI生成的音乐并跟随乐谱。
  - echelon建议开发AI数字音频工作站（DAW），将AI视作艺术家的工具，而非替代人类创作。

补充讨论：
• **技术细节与问题**：rerdavies指出AI生成音乐在左右手音符对齐上的技术问题。
• **跨领域应用**：megadata询问了关于图像转midi/XML/Sibelius的最新工具，这显示了对AI跨领域应用的兴趣。

争议焦点：
• **AI生成音乐是否具备艺术性**：一部分人认为AI音乐缺乏艺术视野和灵魂，另一部分人则认为它在技术上已有一定水平，可以作为工具辅助创作。

总结来看，讨论围绕AI生成音乐的质量、艺术性及其在音乐创作中的应用潜力展开，各方对AI在音乐领域的作用和未来发展持不同看法。

NotaGen Paper
NotaGen Code
🤗
NotaGen Weights
✨️
NotaGen Space
🎵 Click on the music player at the bottom of the webpage and enjoy the music composed by NotaGen! 🎵
(Videos and audio on this page are rendered and exported using Sibelius + NotePerformer.)
Abstract
We introduce
NotaGen
, a symbolic music generation model aims to
explore the potential of producing high-quality classical sheet music
. Inspired by the success of Large Language Models (LLMs), NotaGen adopts
pre-training
,
fine-tuning
, and
reinforcement learning
paradigms (henceforth referred to as the LLM training paradigms). It is pre-trained on 1.6M pieces of music, and then fine-tuned on approximately 9K high-quality classical compositions conditioned on ``period-composer-instrumentation''  prompts. For reinforcement learning, we propose the
CLaMP-DPO
method, which further enhances generation quality and controllability without requiring human annotations or predefined rewards. Our experiments demonstrate the efficacy of CLaMP-DPO in symbolic music generation models with different architectures and encoding schemes. Furthermore, subjective A/B tests show that NotaGen outperforms baseline models against human compositions, greatly advancing musical aesthetics in symbolic music generation.
Data Representation
ABC notation
is a musical notation system that uses a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent musical notes. We adopt a modified version---
interleaved ABC notation
, as our data representation. In this format, different voices of the same bar are rearranged into a single line and differentiated using voice indicators ''[V:]''. Furthermore, we remove bars with full rests.
There have long been misconceptions about the capabilities of ABC notation. For instance, "ABC notation cannot handle multitrack music", "ABC notation is unable to represent complex scores". Actually, ABC is incredibly versatile. Not only can it accommodate multitrack music for any instrumentation, but it can also capture nearly all elements found in Western staff notation system. In addition to notes and rhythms, ABC notation can represent various techniques, expressions, and tempos, as well as flexibly incorporate text annotations.
Model Architecture
NotaGen utilizes the
Tunesformer
architecture and
bar-stream patching
. It consists of two hierarchical GPT-2 decoders: a
patch-level decoder
and a
character-level decoder
. Each patch is flattened by concatenating one-hot character vectors and then passed through a linear layer to obtain the patch embedding. The patch-level decoder captures the temporal relationships among patches, and its final hidden states are passed to the character-level decoder, which auto-regressively predicts the characters of the next patch.
Training Paradigms
Pre-training
NotaGen is pre-trained on
1.6M pieces of music
. This corpus covers a wide range of genres and periods, enabling NotaGen to capture fundamental musical structures and patterns through next-token prediction.
Fine-tuning
NotaGen is fine-tuned on high-quality classical music sheet data to further enhance musicality in generation. We curated a fine-tuning dataset comprising
8,948 classical music sheets
and covering
152 composers
, from
DCML corpora
,
OpenScore String Quartet Corpus
,
OpenScore Lieder Corpus
,
ATEPP
,
KernScores
, and internal resources. We label all the pieces with
3 periods
---Baroque, Classical, and Romantic;
6 instrumentations
---Keyboard, Chamber, Orchestral, Art Song, Choral, and Vocal-Orchestral. Each piece is preprended with a
''period-composer-instrumentation''
prompt for conditional generation.
Reinforcement Learning
To refine both the musicality and the prompt controllability of the fine-tuned NotaGen, we present
CLaMP-DPO
. This method builds upon the principles of Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) and implements
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
. In CLaMP-DPO,
CLaMP 2
, a multimodal symbolic music information retrieval model, serves as the evaluator within the DPO framework, distinguishing between chosen and rejected musical outputs to optimize NotaGen. Our experiments demonstrated that CLaMP-DPO efficiently enhanced both the controllability and the musicality across different symbolic music generation models, irrespective of their data modalities, encoding schemes, or model architectures. This underscores CLaMP-DPO's broad applicability and potential for
auto-regressively trained symbolic music generation models
.

主要讨论点：中国及其他地区可再生能源（特别是太阳能）发展带来的能源价格变化及其影响

不同观点：
• **solid_fuel**：认为能源过剩实际上是文明发展的机会，特别是在计算和软件行业，如训练大型语言模型（LLM）等。能源价格低廉甚至负值时，是扩展计算能力的好时机。

• **energy123**：不同意所谓“能源过剩是不好的预兆”的观点，认为负电价是市场在传递信号，提示需要增加储能或传输设施。市场机制正在正常发挥作用，加州已经根据这些信号做出调整。

• **boringg**：指出大量建设太阳能可能会导致电网稳定性问题，尤其是在没有配套设施的情况下。此外，中国的太阳能产业以出口为主，但面临国内挑战，制造商将经历艰难时期。不过，便宜的电力总体上对国家是利好。

• **0cf8612b2e1e**：强调中国在可再生能源上的巨大投资，显示出其对绿色能源的坚定承诺，投资规模远超其他国家。

• **PaulKeeble**：详细描述了太阳能发展的三个阶段，强调当前许多地区处于痛苦的中期阶段（需要升级传输线路和增加储能）。最终目标是通过足够的太阳能和储能设施实现完全脱碳。并提出夏季“免费”能源的潜在用途，如AI训练和氢气生产。

• **newyankee**：认为当前对能源增长的预测可能低估了其潜在影响，便宜的能源将释放目前被阻碍的其他机会。

• **gotoeleven**：质疑高成本能源来源只有在能源价格高时才有意义的说法。

• **stavros**：对文章主旨感到困惑，认为文章提出的“廉价能源是问题”的观点不清晰。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是廉价能源是否是问题。一部分人（如energy123和solid_fuel）认为这是机会和市场正常运作的结果，而另一部分人（如boringg）则担心电网稳定性和行业挑战。
• PaulKeeble详细解释了太阳能发展的不同阶段，并提出了未来如何利用过剩能源的建设性想法。
• 投资规模和市场信号被认为是影响未来能源结构的重要因素，尤其是中国的巨额投资引发了广泛讨论。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：氢能及其他电化学长期储能技术的可行性与未来前景

不同观点：
• [pjc50] 提出电化学储能系统应具备一系列实际条件，包括使用液体电解质、可逆性、合理的效率和成本、产品的可储存性和安全性等。该评论强调了技术实现的难度，尤其是材料选择和安全性问题。

• [ZeroGravitas] 认为氢能项目虽然有前景，但目前遇到融资困难，许多大型项目正在崩溃。氢能可能只会在未来占据一个小众市场，并且当前的氢能投资主要流向了化石燃料行业，尽管如此，这可能在某种程度上推动了可再生能源的发展。

• [Daniel7890] 强烈支持氢能，认为反氢能的言论是误导性的，并指出中东和北非的大规模氢能项目以及各国政府的支持。该评论认为氢能将终结化石燃料时代，并批评了那些试图阻碍氢能发展的言论和势力，认为其目的是维护化石燃料行业的利益。

• [defrost] 认为氢气直接用作燃料，特别是在小型交通工具中不太现实，但在绿色氨、甲醇和氧化铝生产中仍有 niche 市场。澳大利亚的绿色氢能项目虽然遇到一些停滞，但仍有强大的未来潜力。

• [Permik] 质疑氢能作为燃料源的共识，认为这可能是化石燃料行业的策略，以保持其相关性，因为当前的大部分氢能生产来自化石燃料。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于氢能的实际可行性、成本效益及其与化石燃料行业的关系。
- [pjc50] 提出的技术要求强调了实现电化学储能的复杂性，特别是材料和产品的可储存性、安全性等问题。
- [Daniel7890] 强调了氢能在全球范围内的投资和项目进展，认为反氢能言论是化石燃料行业维护自身利益的工具。
- [ZeroGravitas] 和 [defrost] 则对氢能的当前市场可行性和投资风险持谨慎或怀疑态度，尤其是与化石燃料行业的关系及项目的可持续性。
- [Permik] 的评论则进一步质疑氢能的共识是否是化石燃料行业的策略。

总体来看，讨论围绕氢能及其他电化学储能技术的技术可行性、市场前景及其与化石燃料行业的关系展开，各评论者从不同角度提出了各自的观点和论据。

data.title: Study casts doubt on gluten as cause of gut ailments among non-coeliacs
data.author: pseudolus
data.article_summary: 一项新研究对非乳糜泻患者的谷蛋白敏感性提出质疑。研究发现，自称对谷蛋白敏感的人，无论是否摄入谷蛋白，都会出现腹胀和腹痛等肠道症状。墨尔本大学的Biesiekierski副教授指出，这些症状可能并非由谷蛋白引发，而可能源于"反安慰剂效应"，即预期治疗有害导致负面结果。仅约1%的西方人患有乳糜泻，必须遵循无谷蛋白饮食。而对于自称谷蛋白敏感的约10%的人群，研究建议应咨询营养师，考虑其他饮食触发因素如高FODMAP食物。心理治疗如认知行为疗法和肠道定向催眠疗法也被证明有效。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于小麦、麸质和FODMAPs在消化问题中的作用的不同观点和讨论

不同观点：
• AndrewDucker认为，许多被认为对麸质敏感的人实际上可能对FODMAPs有反应，特别是那些未确诊的IBS患者。他指出，小麦中的FODMAPs会引发他的消化问题，而不是麸质本身。
• dfawcus分享了他的个人经历，指出小麦和barley会引发他的口腔溃疡，虽然他能少量食用，但持续食用会导致问题。他选择避免这两种谷物，而不深究具体的成分。
• foddymap强调了每个人的耐受性是独特的，指出麸质本身不是FODMAP，但含有麸质的小麦和其他谷物常常包含难以消化的FODMAPs。他批评文章将问题简单化，并建议多方面寻求解决方案。
• daotoad提到，许多人在缺乏基本信息的情况下自我诊断为麸质敏感，这可能导致误诊。尽管如此，由于麸质自由食品的增加，他从中受益，并担心如果这些食品因需求减少而停产，自己将失去选择。
• beecasthurlbow指出，研究样本量较小，可能遗漏了对麸质有反应的子群体，并提到其认识的人在无乳糜泻的情况下因麸质引发偏头痛。
• exabrial认为，避免麸质的建议可能是因为许多含麸质的食物是高度加工的食品，而不是麸质本身的问题。
• anenefan批评研究的饮食监控细节不足，并分享了自己对食物添加剂160b（胭脂树）敏感的经历，指出这可能与麸质敏感混淆。
• technothrasher指出，无法证明非乳糜泻麸质敏感不存在，只能显示缺乏其存在的证据，并提到为了避免交叉污染，选择无麸质饮食更为方便。
• mobiuscog提到，没有提到Zonulin（一种与肠道通透性有关的蛋白质），这可能是讨论中的一个遗漏。
• luqtas批评一些医生和健康导向的人群将小麦作为各种问题的根源，并指出乳糜泻的诊断过程复杂且耗时。
• amanaplanacanal分享了个人经验，指出其伴侣对小麦有消化问题，但对barley没有。
• somename9认为，消化问题可能与小麦中的农药如草甘膦有关，而不是麸质本身。
• vidro3对肠道导向的催眠疗法表示怀疑。
• metalman分享了放弃小麦食品后健康改善的经历，并强调了避免加工食品和添加剂的重要性。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到个人经历和自我实验的重要性，强调每个人对食物的反应都是独特的。
• 对研究方法和样本量的批评，指出需要更全面的研究来理解麸质和FODMAPs在消化问题中的作用。
• 无麸质食品市场的变化及其对不同人群的影响也被多次提及。
• 对健康信息和建议的简化与误导表示不满，呼吁更复杂和个性化的解决方案。

Study casts doubt on gluten as cause of gut ailments among non-coeliacs
Research finds people with self-declared gluten sensitivity experienced symptoms whether or not they ate gluten
Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

Donna Lu
Science writer
Wed 26 Mar 2025 10.00 EDT
Last modified on Wed 26 Mar 2025 18.32 EDT
Share
People who report being gluten intolerant but do not have coeliac disease may be experiencing gut symptoms unrelated to gluten intake, new research suggests.
A study involving individuals with self-reported gluten sensitivity has found that they experienced gut symptoms such as bloating and abdominal pain regardless of whether or not they consumed gluten.
Assoc Prof Jessica Biesiekierski of the University of Melbourne, one of the study’s senior authors, said the findings were significant in light of popular blame on gluten as a trigger for various symptoms.
Australians can now use Apple AirPods Pro as hearing aids – but experts warn they’re not for everyone
Read more
Only about 1% of people in western countries have coeliac disease, an autoimmune condition in which gluten causes an inflammatory reaction in the small bowel.
“Coeliac disease is a well-defined medical condition. It has a clear diagnostic pathway,” Biesiekierski said. For people with coeliac disease, a gluten-free diet is the only effective treatment option.
However, about 10% of the population self-report being gluten sensitive. “We’ve got this large number of people who are following a gluten-free diet, possibly unnecessarily,” Biesiekierski said.
Sign up for Guardian Australia’s breaking news email
“Gluten is actually a complex mixture of proteins found in wheat, and related proteins are also present in rye, barley and sometimes oats.
“When you follow a gluten-free diet, you’re excluding an entire group of cereals and grains. Over the long term, this can lead to nutritional inadequacies and is often more costly.”
The study involved 16 participants with non-coeliac gluten sensitivity and 20 healthy controls. Researchers gave participants yoghurt containing either 16g of gluten or whey protein. For five days, the participants also consumed two muffins daily, which each contained either 8g gluten, or no gluten.
After a two-week period, participants were then switched to the other intervention but were not aware of which they were ingesting.
Individuals with gluten-sensitivity reported increased fatigue after both the gluten and placebo yoghurt compared to healthy controls. They also reported increased pain and bloating with both the gluten and gluten-free muffins.
Urine, blood and saliva samples taken for cortisol levels and markers of inflammation showed no differences after gluten ingestion.
“Participants continued to report gastrointestinal symptoms, but these symptoms didn’t appear to be specifically triggered by gluten,” Biesiekierski said. Researchers believe the response to gluten may be explained by a
nocebo effect
, the opposite of the placebo effect, in which a negative outcome results from an expectation that the treatment will be harmful.
At baseline, the gluten-sensitive participants had a higher negative effect, the researchers noted.
“From working with these patient groups for more than 15 years, I can say their symptoms are real. It’s just that, for many of them, gluten may not be the specific cause,” Biesiekierski said.
Previous research
has suggested that fructan, a type of carbohydrate, may be the culprit for abdominal symptoms in people with self-reported gluten sensitivity.

Rather than immediately turning to a gluten-free diet, the researchers suggest people should a consult a dietitian to explore whether other dietary triggers such as high Fodmaps (Fermentable Oligosaccharides, Disaccharides, Monosaccharides and Polyols) foods may be involved.
“We have strong evidence supporting psychological treatments like cognitive behavioural therapy and gut-directed hypnotherapy,” Biesiekierski said. “These approaches help to rewire the gut-brain pathways that may be contributing to the symptoms.”

• anenefan批评研究的饮食监控细节不足，并分享了自己对食物添加剂160b（胭脂树）敏感的经历，指出这可能与麸质敏感混淆。
• technothrasher指出，无法证明非乳糜泻麸质敏感不存在，只能显示缺乏其存在的证据，并提到为了避免交叉污染，选择无麸质饮食更为方便。
• mobiuscog提到，没有提到Zonulin（一种与肠道通透性有关的蛋白质），这可能是讨论中的一个遗漏。
• luqtas批评一些医生和健康导向的人群将小麦作为各种问题的根源，并指出乳糜泻的诊断过程复杂且耗时。
• amanaplanacanal分享了个人经验，指出其伴侣对小麦有消化问题，但对barley没有。
• somename9认为，消化问题可能与小麦中的农药如草甘膦有关，而不是麸质本身。
• vidro3对肠道导向的催眠疗法表示怀疑。
• metalman分享了放弃小麦食品后健康改善的经历，并强调了避免加工食品和添加剂的重要性。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到个人经历和自我实验的重要性，强调每个人对食物的反应都是独特的。
• 对研究方法和样本量的批评，指出需要更全面的研究来理解麸质和FODMAPs在消化问题中的作用。
• 无麸质食品市场的变化及其对不同人群的影响也被多次提及。
• 对健康信息和建议的简化与误导表示不满，呼吁更复杂和个性化的解决方案。

data.author: breadwinner
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一名土耳其留学生因被指支持哈马斯而被撤销签证并逮捕，评论中围绕言论自由、移民权利以及政府干预的合法性和机制展开了讨论。

不同观点：
• [breadwinner] 认为这名学生的行为属于表达意见的范畴，应受第一修正案的保护。该评论指出，这名学生因撰写并发表一篇批评校方处理巴勒斯坦问题态度的文章而被捕，实际上是因其言论自由受到打压。文章中没有发现对哈马斯的直接支持，因此逮捕行动被视为不合理。

• [官方立场] 根据美国国土安全部（DHS）的声明，该学生的签证是特权而非权利，支持外国恐怖组织（如哈马斯）并 glorifying 其行为，构成了撤销签证的正当理由。官方认为，这种支持恐怖组织的行为对国家安全构成威胁，撤销其签证是出于常识性的安全考虑。

• [ggm] 对联邦政府干预的具体机制表示好奇，并提出了一系列问题。该评论质疑是否存在特定的举报机制或技术工具，用于监控并优先处理涉及移民身份的言论或行为。评论还隐含了对政府可能利用技术手段进行监控和信息处理的担忧，并将其与历史上信息处理的负面例子相比较。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于言论自由与国家安全之间的平衡。一部分评论认为，学生的言论属于学术和政治意见的表达，应受宪法保护；而官方则强调，支持被认定为恐怖组织的团体对国家安全构成威胁，必须采取行动。

• [breadwinner] 还提到该学生似乎是在没有预警的情况下被逮捕，这引发了对执法过程是否公正和透明的质疑。

• [ggm] 的评论引出了对政府干预的具体操作流程和技术手段的关注，反映出公众对政府监控和信息处理机制的潜在担忧。

总结：讨论围绕言论自由、移民权利和国家安全展开，主要争议在于表达政治意见是否构成对国家安全的威胁，以及政府在处理此类问题时的机制和合法性。

data.title: NT Synchronization Primitive Driver
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 本文档介绍了Linux内核中ntsync驱动程序的用户空间API，该驱动用于支持用户空间NT模拟器对NT同步原语进行模拟。由于用户空间实现无法在提供准确语义的同时达到Windows的性能，因此需要此驱动。ntsync驱动提供了三种同步原语：信号量、互斥量和事件。信号量使用一个32位计数器，互斥量包含递归计数和所有者标识，事件则有一个布尔状态表示是否被触发。所有操作都是原子的，并且对象通过文件描述符表示，关闭所有文件描述符后对象会被删除。该驱动通过一个字符设备`/dev/ntsync`进行管理，所有操作通过ioctl进行，包括创建信号量、互斥量和事件等。该接口仅用于兼容性目的，不建议用于一般同步。

NT synchronization primitive driver
¶
This page documents the user-space API for the ntsync driver.
ntsync is a support driver for emulation of NT synchronization
primitives by user-space NT emulators. It exists because implementation
in user-space, using existing tools, cannot match Windows performance
while offering accurate semantics. It is implemented entirely in
software, and does not drive any hardware device.
This interface is meant as a compatibility tool only, and should not
be used for general synchronization. Instead use generic, versatile
interfaces such as futex(2) and poll(2).
Synchronization primitives
¶
The ntsync driver exposes three types of synchronization primitives:
semaphores, mutexes, and events.
A semaphore holds a single volatile 32-bit counter, and a static 32-bit
integer denoting the maximum value. It is considered signaled (that is,
can be acquired without contention, or will wake up a waiting thread)
when the counter is nonzero. The counter is decremented by one when a
wait is satisfied. Both the initial and maximum count are established
when the semaphore is created.
A mutex holds a volatile 32-bit recursion count, and a volatile 32-bit
identifier denoting its owner. A mutex is considered signaled when its
owner is zero (indicating that it is not owned). The recursion count is
incremented when a wait is satisfied, and ownership is set to the given
identifier.
A mutex also holds an internal flag denoting whether its previous owner
has died; such a mutex is said to be abandoned. Owner death is not
tracked automatically based on thread death, but rather must be
communicated using
NTSYNC_IOC_MUTEX_KILL
. An abandoned mutex is
inherently considered unowned.
Except for the “unowned” semantics of zero, the actual value of the
owner identifier is not interpreted by the ntsync driver at all. The
intended use is to store a thread identifier; however, the ntsync
driver does not actually validate that a calling thread provides
consistent or unique identifiers.
An event is similar to a semaphore with a maximum count of one. It holds
a volatile boolean state denoting whether it is signaled or not. There
are two types of events, auto-reset and manual-reset. An auto-reset
event is designaled when a wait is satisfied; a manual-reset event is
not. The event type is specified when the event is created.
Unless specified otherwise, all operations on an object are atomic and
totally ordered with respect to other operations on the same object.
Objects are represented by files. When all file descriptors to an
object are closed, that object is deleted.
Char device
¶
The ntsync driver creates a single char device /dev/ntsync. Each file
description opened on the device represents a unique instance intended
to back an individual NT virtual machine. Objects created by one ntsync
instance may only be used with other objects created by the same
instance.
ioctl reference
¶
All operations on the device are done through ioctls. There are four
structures used in ioctl calls:
struct ntsync_sem_args {
__u32 count;
__u32 max;
};
struct ntsync_mutex_args {
__u32 owner;
__u32 count;
};
struct ntsync_event_args {
__u32 signaled;
__u32 manual;
};
struct ntsync_wait_args {
__u64 timeout;
__u64 objs;
__u32 count;
__u32 owner;
__u32 index;
__u32 alert;
__u32 flags;
__u32 pad;
};
Depending on the ioctl, members of the structure may be used as input,
output, or not at all.
The ioctls on the device file are as follows:
NTSYNC_IOC_CREATE_SEM
¶
Create a semaphore object. Takes a pointer to struct
ntsync_sem_args
, which is used as follows:
count
Initial count of the semaphore.
max
Maximum count of the semaphore.
Fails with
EINVAL
if
count
is greater than
max
.
On success, returns a file descriptor the created semaphore.
NTSYNC_IOC_CREATE_MUTEX
¶
Create a mutex object. Takes a pointer to struct
ntsync_mutex_args
, which is used as follows:
count
Initial recursion count of the mutex.
owner
Initial owner of the mutex.
If
owner
is nonzero and
count
is zero, or if
owner
is
zero and
count
is nonzero, the function fails with
EINVAL
.
On success, returns a file descriptor the created mutex.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一名人士因其发表的亲巴勒斯坦言论而成为针对目标，并被取消签证的事件

不同观点：
• [jauntywundrkind] 认为该人士是因为撰写了特定文章（链接指向一篇发表在《Tufts Daily》的文章）而成为针对目标，并被取消签证。暗示其遭遇可能与发表的政治观点有关。

• [garyfirestorm] 质疑执法行为的合法性和合宪性，指出如果执法行为是合法且符合宪法的，为何执法人员要戴面具并穿着便衣。这暗示了对执法透明度和动机的怀疑。

• [engels_gibs] 认为该事件的核心信息——即该人士因撰写亲巴勒斯坦的评论文章并被视为“反以色列”而遭到拘留——未被充分揭示或强调。他们质疑为何这一重要信息未在标题中提及，暗示媒体报道可能存在偏见或信息不全。

补充讨论：
• [gnabgib] 提供了一个讨论链接（指向Hacker News上的一个讨论帖，获得55个点赞，2小时内有19条评论），暗示该事件在其他平台上也引起了广泛关注和讨论。

争议焦点：
1. 该事件的合法性和执法行为的透明度。

data.title: Ferrous Systems Donates Ferrocene Language Specification to Rust Project
data.author: mjw1007
data.article_summary: 2025年，Ferrous Systems将其Ferrocene语言规范（FLS）捐赠给Rust项目，以帮助创建官方的Rust语言规范。Rust自2015年发布1.0版本以来，广受开发者欢迎，但一直缺乏官方语言规范。2022年12月，Rust项目开始探讨制定规范，并在2023年7月批准了相关提案。然而，Ferrous Systems早在2022年就为安全关键行业开发了FLS。为避免行业内出现多个Rust规范导致混淆，Rust项目的t-spec团队决定将FLS与Rust参考文档整合，并与Ferrous Systems合作。Ferrous Systems同意捐赠FLS，帮助Rust项目加快官方规范的制定，这将为开发者和相关行业提供权威参考，标志着Rust生态系统的一个重要里程碑。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust语言的规范文档及其在高端领域（如高完整性、高保障任务关键领域）的应用前景

不同观点：
• [crvdgc的观点] 认为该规范文档主要是描述性散文，而不是编程语言理论层面的形式化规范。尽管觉得有规范比没有好，但其期望看到更具理论深度的形式化说明，尤其是针对工业一致性目的的文档。
  
• [eggy的观点] 认为当前的规范是一个好的开始，有助于让Rust进入像Ada/SPARK这样的高完整性领域。他期望未来能够有更稳定的版本，以避免频繁更新规范，并指出工具支持和稳定性是这些高端应用领域广泛采纳的关键。他还提到了Rust与Ada/SPARK之间的相互借鉴是有益的。

补充讨论：
• [eggy] 提到了SPARK因其工具支持和在任务关键领域的应用，使得他的项目选择了SPARK，并指出SPARK 2014（基于Ada 2012）的稳定性促进了其广泛应用。他希望Rust也能朝这个方向发展。

• 争议的焦点在于规范的深度和实用性。[crvdgc] 更关注规范的理论性和形式化，而[eggy] 则更看重实际的工业应用和稳定性，并认为当前的规范是一个合理的起点。

• 两者都提到了Rust与Ada/SPARK的比较，[eggy] 认为这种比较是有积极意义的，而[crvdgc] 则隐含了对Rust规范在理论深度上不如Ada/SPARK的失望。

总结来看，讨论主要围绕Rust规范的理论性与实用性之间的平衡，以及其在高端领域应用的前景。

Ferrous Systems Donates Ferrocene Language Specification to Rust Project
March 26, 2025
/
Rust Foundation Team
Rust 1.0 was published in May 2015. As the language approaches its 10th anniversary, Rust has become one of the fastest growing and
most-loved languages
[1] among developers, thanks to a combination of speed, safety and a vibrant community.
Like any growing open source language, Rust has a considerable amount of documentation and tutorials provided by the
Rust Project
[2]. Included in the online library are the official
Rust book
[3]
Rust Reference
[4],
courses and tutorials
[5], and more. However, there is an important piece of documentation missing that many other languages provide: an official language specification.
In December 2022, an
RFC
[6] was submitted to encourage the Rust Project to begin working on a specification. After much discussion, the RFC was approved in July 2023, and work began. Initially, the Rust Project specification team (
t-spec
[7]) were interested in creating the document from scratch using the Rust Reference as a guiding marker. However, the team knew there was already an external Rust specification that was being used successfully for compiler qualification purposes – the FLS.
The FLS is a description of the Rust programming language, developed by
Ferrous Systems
[8] in July 2022 as part of
Ferrocene
[9], a Rust compiler and toolchain designed for safety-critical and regulated industries. The FLS provides a structured and detailed reference for Rust’s syntax, semantics, and behavior, serving as a foundation for verification, compliance, and standardization efforts. Since Rust did not have an official language specification back then, nor a plan to write one, the FLS represented a major step toward describing Rust in a way that aligns with industry requirements, particularly in high-assurance domains.
The t-spec team wanted to avoid potential confusion from having two highly visible Rust specifications in the industry and so decided it would be worthwhile to try to integrate the FLS with the Rust Reference to create the official Rust Project specification. They approached Ferrous Systems, which agreed to contribute its FLS to the Rust Project and allow the Rust Project to take over its development and management.
The Rust Foundation is excited to announce that Ferrous Systems has agreed to contribute its Ferrocene Language Specification (FLS) to the Rust Project. This generous donation will provide a clearer path to delivering an official Rust specification. It will also empower the Rust Project to oversee its ongoing evolution, providing confidence to companies and individuals already relying on the FLS, and marking a major milestone for the Rust ecosystem.
“I really appreciate Ferrous taking this step to provide their specification to the Rust Project,” said Joel Marcey, Director of Technology at the Rust Foundation and member of the t-spec team. “They have already done a massive amount of legwork. Having the FLS integrated officially into the Rust Project will allow the t-spec team to supercharge our progress in the delivery of an official Rust specification that can be utilized by developers, safety-critical tool vendors, and others that look to a language specification for their work.”
“We originally created the Ferrocene Language Specification to provide a structured and reliable description of Rust for the certification of the Ferrocene compiler,” said Felix Gilcher, Co-founder of Ferrous Systems. “As an open source-first company, contributing the FLS to the Rust Project is a logical step toward fostering the development of a unified, community-driven specification that benefits all Rust users. We are glad to support this effort and look forward to the long-term impact this will have on Rust’s adoption in regulated and high-assurance domains.”
There will be a transition period as the FLS is integrated into the Rust Project. The first phase of work will involve incorporating FLS into the Project’s tooling and processes, in alignment with existing
Rust Project goals
[10].
Once the integration is complete, Ferrous Systems will be able to rely on the Project’s version of the specification and discontinue their own. More broadly, this effort will provide others who require a Rust specification with an official, authoritative reference for their work with the Rust programming language.
Moving forward, both the FLS and the Rust Reference will be utilized to form the official Rust Specification. This is an exciting outcome.

data.title: Iran using drones and apps to enforce women's dress code
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: 伊朗正在利用无人机和手机应用程序来强制执行女性的着装规定，尤其是严格的头巾法。联合国报告指出，伊朗通过"国家支持的义务警员行为"鼓励民众使用专门的应用程序举报违反头巾规定的女性，包括在出租车和救护车内的乘客。此外，伊朗还使用无人机和监控摄像头监控女性的着装 compliance。对于违反规定的女性，可能面临逮捕、殴打，甚至在拘押期间遭遇性暴力。报告还揭示了伊朗司法系统缺乏独立性，以及对抗议者的法外处决和酷刑。这些发现将提交给人权理事会，凸显了伊朗女性面临的系统性歧视和镇压。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：伊朗政权性质及其与西方世界的关系

不同观点：
• suraci认为伊朗从叙利亚的教训中吸取经验，即一个世俗政权会成为西方世界的敌人，而一个宗教性的恐怖政权反而获得了如德国外长的认可。这一观点暗示西方国家对不同类型政权的双重标准。

• falcor84引用了《使女的故事》作为对伊朗伊斯兰革命的映射，认为现实往往比虚构更加离奇，暗示伊朗的宗教政权导致了极端的社会控制和压迫，与虚构作品的设想相似。

• dp-hackernews提到了乔治·奥威尔的《1984》，可能是在暗示极权主义政权（无论是宗教性的还是世俗性的）都会导致类似的压迫性社会环境，并将伊朗的情况与经典反乌托邦小说中的情景相比较。

补充讨论：
- suraci的观点中包含对西方国家外交政策的不满，认为其对世俗和宗教政权的不同态度存在矛盾。
- falcor84通过文学作品《使女的故事》提供了一个理解伊朗伊斯兰革命后果的文化视角。
- dp-hackernews的评论引发对不同极权主义政权的比较，特别是通过《1984》这一经典作品来探讨政权性质与社会控制的关系。
- 争议的焦点可能在于西方国家对不同类型政权的认可标准，以及这些政权对社会的实际影响。

Iran using drones and apps to enforce women's dress code
14 March 2025
Share
Save
Imogen Foulkes
Geneva correspondent, BBC News
Tom McArthur
BBC News
Share
Save
EPA
Refusing to wear the hijab in public can lead to imprisonment in Iran
Iran is using drones and intrusive digital technology to crush dissent, especially among women who refuse to obey the Islamic republic's strict dress code, the United Nations has said.
Investigators say Iranian security officials are using a strategy of "state-sponsored vigilantism" to encourage people to use specialist phone apps to report women for alleged dress code violations in private vehicles such as taxis and ambulances.
Their new report also highlights the increasing use of drones and security cameras to monitor hijab compliance in Tehran and in southern Iran.
For women who defy the laws, or protest against them, the consequences are severe – arrest, beating, and even rape in custody.
Iranian women 'ready to pay the price' for defying hijab rules
A really simple guide to the protests in Iran
Iran reportedly executed at least 901 people in 2024, UN says
The findings
of the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on the Islamic Republic of Iran come after it determined last year that the country's theocracy
was responsible for the "physical violence" that led to the death in custody of Mahsa Amini in 2022
.
Witnesses said the 22-year-old Kurd was badly beaten by the morality police during her arrest, but authorities denied she was mistreated and blamed "sudden heart failure" for her death. Her killing sparked a massive wave of protests that continues today, despite threats of violent arrest and imprisonment.
"Two-and-a-half years after the protests began in September 2022, women and girls in Iran continue to face systematic discrimination, in law and in practice, that permeates all aspects of their lives, particularly with respect to the enforcement of the mandatory hijab," the report said.
"The state is increasingly reliant on state-sponsored vigilantism in an apparent effort to enlist businesses and private individuals in hijab compliance, portraying it as a civic responsibility."
At Tehran's Amirkabir University, authorities installed facial recognition software at its entrance gate to also find women not wearing the hijab, the report said.
Surveillance cameras
on Iran's major roads are also being used to search for uncovered women
.
Investigators also said they obtained the "Nazer" mobile phone app offered by Iranian police, which allows "vetted" members of the public and the police to report on uncovered women in vehicles, including ambulances, buses, metro cars and taxis.
"Users may add the location, date, time and the licence plate number of the vehicle in which the alleged mandatory hijab infraction occurred, which then 'flags' the vehicle online, alerting the police," the report said.
According to the report, a text message is then sent to the registered owner of the vehicle, warning them they had been found in violation of the mandatory hijab laws. Vehicles could be impounded for ignoring the warnings, it added.
The UN investigators interviewed almost 300 victims and witnesses – they also looked in-depth at Iran's judicial system, which they said lacks any real independence. Victims of torture and other violations were also persecuted while their families were "systematically intimidated", according to their report.
They also found evidence of the extrajudicial executions of three child and three adult protesters, later dismissed by the state as suicides.
The report also established additional cases of sexual violence in custody, citing the case of one arrested woman who was beaten severely, subjected to two mock executions, raped and then gang-raped.
The report will be presented to the Human Rights Council on 18 March.

• dp-hackernews提到了乔治·奥威尔的《1984》，可能是在暗示极权主义政权（无论是宗教性的还是世俗性的）都会导致类似的压迫性社会环境，并将伊朗的情况与经典反乌托邦小说中的情景相比较。

- suraci的观点中包含对西方国家外交政策的不满，认为其对世俗和宗教政权的不同态度存在矛盾。
- falcor84通过文学作品《使女的故事》提供了一个理解伊朗伊斯兰革命后果的文化视角。
- dp-hackernews的评论引发对不同极权主义政权的比较，特别是通过《1984》这一经典作品来探讨政权性质与社会控制的关系。
- 争议的焦点可能在于西方国家对不同类型政权的认可标准，以及这些政权对社会的实际影响。

data.title: Faster interpreters in Go: Catching up with C++
data.author: krvajal
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Vitess数据库中的SQL评估引擎的演变和优化过程。最初，该引擎是一个直接操作SQL抽象语法树（AST）的解释器。为了提高性能，团队用一个用Go语言编写的虚拟机（VM）替代了原来的解释器。这个新的VM在性能上接近MySQL的C++评估代码，且更易维护。Vitess的评估引擎负责处理分布在多个MySQL实例上的复杂SQL查询，支持大部分MySQL的标量表达式。为了确保与MySQL的兼容性，团队投入大量精力匹配MySQL的行为，并通过全面的测试发现了MySQL本身的若干bug。最终，新的VM在性能和准确性上都达到了预期目标，确保了查询的高效执行。

Faster interpreters in Go: Catching up with C++
By
Vicent MartÃ­
|
March 20, 2025
The SQL evaluation engine that ships with Vitess,
the open-source database that powers PlanetScale
, was originally implemented as an AST evaluator that used to operate directly on the SQL AST generated by our parser. Over this past year, we've gradually replaced it with a Virtual Machine which, despite being written natively in Go, performs similarly to the original C++ evaluation code in MySQL. Most remarkably, the new Virtual Machine has repeatedly proven itself easier to maintain than the original Go interpreter, even though it's orders of magnitude faster. Let's review the implementation choices we've made to get these surprising results.
What's a SQL evaluation engine?
Vitess has been designed for unlimited horizontal scaling. To accomplish this, all queries to a Vitess cluster must go through a
vtgate
. Since you can deploy as many
vtgate
instances as you want, because theyâre essentially stateless, this allows you to grow the capacity of your cluster linearly.  The job of each gate is the most complex part of the whole distributed system. It parses the SQL of the incoming queries and creates a shard-aware query plan, which we evaluate in one or many of the shards of the cluster. Then, we aggregate the results of these evaluations, and return them to the user.
One of the reasons why Vitess works so well in practice (in both performance and in ease of adoption) is that every shard in a cluster is backed by a real MySQL instance. Even the more complex SQL queries can be decomposed into simpler statements that are evaluated in the underlying MySQL database. Hence, the results of these queries always match what youâd expect from querying MySQL directly.
However, SQL queries in the real world can get
really wild
. We need to support pretty much every kind of query that a normal MySQL instance supports, but we need to evaluate it across several MySQL instances. This means that sometimes, we donât get to fall back to MySQL to evaluate all our SQL expressions.
Think of a rather simple query such as this:
SELECT inventory.item_id, SUM(inventory.count), AVG(inventory.price) AS avg_price
FROM inventory
WHERE inventory.state = 'available' AND inventory.warehouse IN ?
GROUP BY inventory.item_id
HAVING  avg_price > 100;
Assuming this query is executed in a sharded Vitess cluster, the inventoried items can exist in any of the shards. Hence, our query planner will prepare a plan that queries all shards in parallel,
pushing down part of the aggregation to MySQL
, and then we'll perform the aggregations (
SUM
and
AVG
) locally in the
vtgate
. The
state
and
warehouse
checks in the
WHERE
clause can and will be executed directly on the MySQL instance that powers each shard. But the last expression,
avg_price > 100
, applies to the result of the aggregation, which is only available inside Vitess. This is where the Vitess evaluation engine comes in.
Our evaluation engine is an interpreter that supports the majority of the scalar expressions in the SQL dialect used by MySQL. This does not include high level constructs such as performing a
JOIN
,  the grouping of a
GROUP BY
, etc (these are performed directly by the planner, as weâve seen), but the actual sub-expressions that youâd see as the condition of a
WHERE
clause, or a
GROUP BY
clause. Any piece of SQL that cannot be lowered to be executed in MySQL by the planner is evaluated locally in Go by the engine.
Of course, these SQL sub-expressions are not arbitrarily complex. They are not even Turing complete (as they cannot loop!), so you may think that a statement like
avg_price > ?
would be trivial to evaluate, but as in most engineering problems, thereâs a wealth of nuance when doing these things in the real world.
SQL is an incredibly dynamic language full of quirks, and the SQL in MySQL, doubly so. We have spent an inordinate amount of time getting every single corner case of SQL evaluation to match exactly MySQLâs behavior. In fact, our
test
suite
and
fuzzer
are so comprehensive that we routinely find bugs in the original MySQL evaluation engine, which we have to fix upstream (
like this collation bug
,
this issue in the
insert
SQL function
or
this bug when searching substrings
). Nonetheless, being fully accurate is not enough. For most queries, these expressions are evaluated once or even more than once
for every returned row
, so in order to not introduce additional overhead, evaluation needs to be as quick as possible.

data.title: Stamp fanatic professor stole 3k items from Scotland's national archive
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 苏格兰国家档案馆揭露了一起历史性盗窃案，共3,000多份文件在30年间被一名历史学教授大卫·麦克米伦（Prof David Macmillan）盗走。麦克米伦对邮票和邮戳有着浓厚兴趣，他利用访问档案馆的机会实施盗窃，主要窃取家庭、地产和商业信件。这些文件在2012年被发现藏于加拿大特伦特大学档案馆，之后陆续归还。虽然麦克米伦未被定罪，但档案馆确信其为窃贼。加强的安全措施现已实施，以保护这些具有近千年历史的苏格兰历史文件。

View image in fullscreen

Stamp fanatic professor stole 3,000 items from Scotland’s national archive
Academic who died in 1987 is thought to be responsible for documents that vanished over a 30-year period
Libby Brooks
Scotland correspondent
Tue 25 Mar 2025 07.55 EDT
Last modified on Tue 25 Mar 2025 08.28 EDT
Share
Scotland’s national archive has traced the mysterious disappearance of more than 3,000 historical documents over a period of 30 years to a history professor with an all-consuming interest in stamps.
The theft began to unravel when a National Records of Scotland archivist attended an auction in London in 1994. There, he discovered that 200 of the items for sale belonged to the archive, some still marked with their NRS reference numbers.
The items, 3,100 items in total, mainly family, estate and business correspondence, were traced back to an academic and archivist, Prof David Macmillan, who died in 1987. Born in Ayrshire, Macmillan studied history at the University of Glasgow before teaching at the University of Sydney and then Trent University in Ontario, Canada, where he was a professor for 20 years.
Records showed that he made annual visits to the NRS archives as a user from 1969 until 1980, when he was caught taking a single item from the archive in
Edinburgh
and his access was immediately revoked. It was assumed at the time that this was an isolated incident.
View image in fullscreen
The postmarks on this letter, from 1813, are thought to have made it attractive to Prof Macmillan.
Photograph: National Records of Scotland
But the scale of his thefts became apparent in 2012, when a researcher saw a reference in an online catalogue at Trent University to an item he thought may have belonged in Scotland and raised concerns. NRS archivists went on to discover about 2,900 items which had been stolen by Macmillan and then gifted to Trent University’s archives after his death.
Although Prof Macmillan was not convicted of any offences, NRS is confident that he carried out the thefts, which experts believe were motivated by his interest in stamps and postmarks. The correspondence he took was not of high financial or historical value, and it remains a mystery why someone whose own working life was sustained by the use of archives would abuse the trust of these institutions in such a blatant manner.
View image in fullscreen
Dr Alan Borthwick, head of medieval and early modern records.
Photograph: National Records of Scotland
Dr Alan Borthwick, head of medieval and early modern records at NRS, said: “In essence he was looking for correspondence, especially from parts of the world where Scots were involved in general personal or business matters, but also routine domestic correspondence, which might turn out to have unusual postmarks – a bit magpie-like, he was attracted by something ‘shiny’ even if most people couldn’t see the attraction.”
NRS now has almost all its documents back in their rightful position, overseen by more robust security measures than Macmillan encountered, which protect its collection of 38m documents spanning nearly 1,000 years of Scottish history.
Of the 3,100 items returned, about 2,000 were stolen from the NRS archives, with others taken directly from other institutions across the UK including the National Archives and the University of Glasgow, the University of Edinburgh and the National Library of Scotland.
About 500 items were found to belong to collections held by private owners, and 100 items remain of unknown origin.
Alison Byrne, chief executive of NRS, said: “These historical thefts were on an unprecedented scale and carried out we believe by one individual who was a regular visitor to the institutions he stole from.
“Thanks to the highly detailed and painstaking work of NRS archivists, we have been able to restore these records to their original collections and ensure they are available for study once again.”

data.author: sharjeelsayed
data.article_summary: 《HN Popularity Contest》一文介绍了在Hacker News上受欢迎的个人博客排名情况。文章提供了多种时间范围的选择，如全部时间、去年、最近12个月和过去5年等，用户可以自定义时间区间查看博客排名。排名依据总分进行评估，列出了域名、总得分、作者、作者简介及涉及的主题和提交数量。用户还可以设置显示结果的数量限制，如100、250、500、1000或5000个。文章还提到若有错误，可以进行更正。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Hacker News 博客排名、SEO 以及博客作者身份和内容的相关性

不同观点：
• **关于博客排名和SEO竞争**：
  - otras 提到自己和一个同名开发者的博客在SEO排名上竞争，并指出一个足球运动员在普通搜索下排名更高，但加上“开发者”或“编程”关键词后，同名开发者排名更高。他认为这是因为对方更持续地发布技术文章。
  
• **关于排名数据的准确性与修正**：
  - mtlynch（作者）感谢大家的兴趣，并表示愿意接受建议和修改，提供了修改其排名的 GitHub 链接。
  - jstanley 指出自己的博客被错误地归到David Given名下，并请求修正。
  
• **关于特定博客的纳入与排除**：
  - omoikane 对Ken Shirriff的博客未进入前5000名表示惊讶，并指出该博客似乎被明确排除在外。
  
• **对博客排名结果的个人反应**：
  - bobbiechen 对自己博客进入前5000名感到惊讶，并认为Hacker News 社区既大又亲密。
  - Swizec 对自己博客排名511感到惊喜，但遗憾没有作者信息或标签，并分享了Hacker News 对他职业生涯的积极影响。
  - marginalia_nu 对自己进入前75名感到自豪。
  - larsiusprime 对自己博客排名265感到高兴，但指出博客的作者名被误标。
  
• **关于博客作者身份的争议**：
  - throwawayk7h 提到Slate Star Codex和Astral Codex Ten应该合并，并指出后者作者被正确列为Scott Alexander，而前者却被标记为匿名。
  
• **关于博客平台的讨论**：
  - OgsyedIE 提到多数高排名博客是自托管的，但仍有部分博客托管在Blogger、Ghost或Medium上，并认为该数据集对预测不同博客主机的强度可能有价值。
  
• **关于博客聚合的建议**：
  - tathagatadg 建议提供类似 RSS 订阅的聚合方式，方便查看这些博客内容。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户如 surprisetalk 提供了他们维护的Hacker News博客列表链接，并欢迎大家提交或修正。
• account-5 分享了从某博客学到的关于主动和被动语态的知识，并将其应用到工作场景中，侧面反映了博客内容的实际帮助。

争议焦点：
• 博客排名的准确性及归因问题（如作者名错误和特定博客的排除）是主要争议点。

主要讨论点：选择合适的全栈开发技术栈，特别是涉及AI和REST API的场景

不同观点：
• [vlod] 认为可以使用Ruby on Rails (RoR)快速构建原型，即便遇到问题也可以通过询问他人解决，最终可以评估工具是否合适。如果失败，也可以验证想法是否值得继续开发。
• [matt_s] 提出，只要是通过HTTP API与AI进行集成，任何技术栈都可以，因为它们都可以调用API。如果需要自建AI/ML模型，则技术栈选择会更有限。选择像RoR或Python/Django这样的成熟技术栈，AI助手会更有帮助。
• [bionhoward] 推荐了一套具体的技术组合：HTML/CSS/JS作为前端，Axum作为后端，Redis/Valkey作为KV缓存，PostgreSQL作为数据库。
• [PapaPalpatine] 支持Rails，认为它是适合单人开发者的框架。
• [CameronBird] 推荐Laravel，认为它是一个包含齐全功能的框架，可以让开发者快速进入应用核心部分，并提到Laravel提供了快速部署的工具和资源。
• [ativzzz] 认为选择技术栈应基于开发者的熟悉程度，因为在开发过程中难免会遇到需要深入解决问题的情况。
• [ejs] 提出应根据具体项目需求选择技术栈，并表示自己常用Elixir/Phoenix。
• [devgoth] 选择了Go + HTMX + Go Templates，主要是为了学习Go语言，并对这种组合表示满意。
• [yusufnb] 推荐使用TypeScript作为全栈开发语言，前端和后端都用TypeScript，必要时用Python创建ML服务。认为这样可以共享代码和类型，避免上下文切换。
• [indiantinker] 认为选择技术栈是高度个人化的，但推荐TypeScript，并提到如果做代理工作可以用FastAPI封装的Python服务。
• [myphone8356] 选择Go标准库、SQLite和HTML，追求简单。
• [mixmastamyk] 支持Django，认为它是一个高效的选择，并推荐搭配PostgreSQL和Htmx。
• [hankchinaski] 表示自己用Go、HTMX、Tailwind JS和PostgreSQL非常高效。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于技术栈的选择是否应基于个人熟悉程度还是项目需求。例如，[ativzzz]和[ejs]强调根据个人经验选择，而[yusufnb]和[myphone8356]则分别推荐TypeScript和Go的简单组合。
- 具体技术推荐中，RoR、Laravel、Django、Go等都被提及，各有支持者，且各自的理由包括开发效率、生态系统支持和个人熟悉程度。

data.title: Is Robert Frost Even a Good Poet?
data.author: lermontov
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：罗伯特·弗罗斯特的诗歌及其解读，凯文·墨菲的讲座，以及弗罗斯特在文学和教育中的地位。

不同观点：
• jll29认为凯文·墨菲的讲座深刻揭示了公众对弗罗斯特的误解，尤其是对《未选择的路》这首诗的误读。墨菲的讲解打破了常规看法，令人深思。
• alabastervlog提到写作和研究项目的耗时性，并将其与软件开发的估算相比较，暗示长期项目的不可预测性。
• marko-k强调弗罗斯特常被误解，推荐了几首不太知名但值得一读的诗歌，如《桦树》和《女巫之歌》。
• archiepeach介绍了一款自制的诗歌应用程序，强调用户体验，并提到使用AI进行诗歌分析，但未在应用中明确说明。
• dkga表示对弗罗斯特的喜爱，并提到正在录制弗罗斯特的诗歌，认为墨菲的讲座提供了有价值的额外信息。
• Hizonner对弗罗斯特的评价不高，认为他的影响力已经下降。
• lupire引用Plunkett的观点，指出弗罗斯特的诗歌具有表面简单但内含深刻评论的特点，认为对诗歌的解读不应过于自信。
• jonahx引用Plunkett的另一个观点，讨论了文化中对时间和复杂性关系的误解，并提到对文学的评价常带有偏见。
• nimish用现代商业术语"产品市场适配"来形容弗罗斯特的诗歌及其影响，认为其具有广泛的吸引力。
• zoeysmithe通过引用Plunkett的讨论，分析了弗罗斯特对高等教育的批评及其在大学中的角色，指出弗罗斯特对制度化的怀疑和理想主义的复杂态度。

补充讨论：
• 凯文·墨菲的讲座被认为是揭示弗罗斯特及其诗歌误解的宝贵资源。
• 有人提到AI在诗歌分析中的应用，以及如何在应用程序中呈现这种技术。
• 对弗罗斯特的评价存在争议，有人赞赏其深度，有人认为其影响力下降。
• 讨论中涉及了弗罗斯特对高等教育的批判态度，以及他在大学中的角色和影响。

这些观点展示了弗罗斯特作品的复杂性和多面性，以及不同读者和学者对其作品的不同解读和评价。

data.title: Zorin OS says goodbye to Firefox in latest 17.3 update
data.author: bundie
data.article_summary: Zorin OS 17.3 今日发布，主打隐私保护和用户体验提升，特别适合无法运行 Windows 11 的设备作为 Windows 10 的替代品。新版增加了超过 150 个 Windows 应用的替代方案，并会在尝试运行 Windows 程序时推荐原生应用。此外，由于 Mozilla 对 Firefox 用户隐私条款的修改，Zorin OS 17.3 将默认浏览器更换为修改版的 Brave 浏览器。Zorin Connect 应用也进行了界面 redesign，支持更多功能如远程输入和媒体共享。触屏用户可以启用屏幕键盘按钮。系统预装了最新 NVIDIA 驱动，并提供软件更新支持至 2027 年。现有用户可通过软件更新升级，新版包括 Pro、Core 和 Education 三个版本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Brave浏览器的功能和使用体验的讨论

不同观点：
• 观点一：Brave浏览器缺乏一些重要功能，如容器功能。  
  - 论据：Zorin系统默认的Brave浏览器不支持容器功能，用户需要下载Firefox来恢复此功能。  
  - 例子：通过Firefox可以实现容器化，而在Brave中无法直接实现。

• 观点二：Brave浏览器支持uBlock Origin，并且在广告屏蔽方面表现良好。  
  - 论据：Brave浏览器目前支持manifest v2，并且可以运行完整的uBlock Origin扩展。  
  - 例子：用户提到使用uBlock Origin来屏蔽广告，并且指出Brave的自带广告屏蔽功能与uBlock Origin不同。

• 观点三：Brave浏览器的自带广告屏蔽功能引发争议。  
  - 论据：有用户对Brave自带的非uBlock Origin广告屏蔽器表示不满或疑虑，认为uBlock Origin在屏蔽非广告内容（如AI功能集成）方面更有效。  
  - 例子：用户提到使用uBlock Origin来屏蔽不想要的AI功能集成，而Brave自带的屏蔽功能可能不足。

• 观点四：Brave浏览器在特定使用场景下有其独特优势。  
  - 论据：用户在桌面环境中使用Brave浏览器来隔离Google登录，认为这是一个有效的使用场景。  
  - 例子：用户在五台设备中的一台上使用Brave，目的是为了隔离Google登录，避免与其他浏览活动混淆。

• 观点五：Brave浏览器相比Opera和Edge有优势。  
  - 论据：用户认为Brave浏览器在某些方面优于Opera和Edge，尽管没有详细说明具体优势。  
  - 例子：仅提及Brave不是Opera或Edge，暗示用户可能对后两者有负面评价。

补充讨论：
- 用户对Brave浏览器的一些功能不足表示关注，但也有用户在特定使用场景下找到其价值。
- 争议焦点在于Brave自带的广告屏蔽功能与uBlock Origin的比较，以及容器功能的缺失。
- 总体来看，用户对Brave的评价褒贬不一，取决于具体使用需求和偏好。

43487877.article_content:
Zorin OS 17.3 has been
announced today
, promising new features centered around privacy and an enhanced user experience. Zorin Group kicked off its announcement by pointing out that Windows 10 is reaching its end of life this October.
Zorin Group is positioning its Ubuntu-based distro as the "ideal replacement," especially for devices that can’t handle Windows 11’s system requirements. If you’re in that boat, though, Paul also
suggests giving Linux Mint a shot
.
With 17.3, there is now an expanded database containing over 150 alternatives to Windows applications. Zorin OS allows you to run Windows applications thanks to the Wine compatibility layer, but there's nothing better than native applications on native platforms. Now, when you launch a Windows installer for an app, Zorin OS 17.3 will suggest native alternatives.
For example, Obsidian, the popular "
file over app
" note-taking application, ships with variants for Linux, macOS, and Windows. If you try to run the Windows .exe file on Zorin OS 17.3, the system will recommend the Linux version.
You've probably heard about the
recent controversial policy changes
Mozilla made. If you somehow haven't, here's a brief recap: Last month, Mozilla modified its Terms of Use for Firefox, stating that by using Firefox, you granted it a "nonexclusive, royalty-free license" to utilize information input through the browser. That's not all. In the Mozilla Bedrock project, the following code block was also
removed
:
Does Firefox sell your personal data?
Nope. Never have, never will. And we protect you from many of the advertisers who do. Firefox products are designed to protect your privacy. That's a promise.
This did not sit well with many, and Zorin Group is one of them. That's why, in 17.3, Zorin OS is ditching Firefox as its default browser in favor of a lightly modified Brave. Zorin Group says the following requirements were set when considering a replacement for Firefox:
Free and
Open Source
software.
A general-purpose, full-featured web browser.
It should support common use cases, including playing copyright-protected content from popular streaming services.
Privacy-respecting.
Popular and recognizable.
Mature and well-maintained.
This is especially important for reliability and the quick availability of security patches.
Moving on, the Zorin Connect app has received a redesigned interface that adapts to your Android device's theme, alongside other improvements. For example, the "Remote Input" functionality now includes new features like middle-click, compose and send text, and a gyroscope mouse option.
Other improvements to the Zorin Connect app include the following:
Share web links to disconnected computers, to be opened when they connect later
Allow having different home screen widgets for different computers
Send album art for playing media from phone to computer
Direct Share targets in Android share dialogs
Allow filtering notifications from a
Work Profile
Added more fine-grained notification channels
Search by app name in the notification plugin settings
Added the option to cancel a pairing request after sending it
Accessibility improvements
Bug fixes & performance enhancements
If you're a touchscreen user, you'll notice that in 17.3, you can now open the on-screen keyboard from the panel once you enable the "Screen Keyboard Button in Panel" option under "Interface" in Zorin Appearance.
Other changes Zorin OS brings include updates to pre-installed apps. The latest NVIDIA 570 drivers are now included in the .iso files, bringing support for the newest NVIDIA RTX 5000 series graphics cards. Zorin Group promises software updates and patches until June 2027 for users of the Zorin OS 17 version series.
For existing Zorin OS users, there are two recommended ways to get Zorin OS 17.3. If you're on Zorin OS 17, you can upgrade to 17.3 using the Software Updater. If you're on version 16, you'll need to follow this
guide on how to upgrade
.
As with other Zorin OS versions, 17.3 comes in three editions:
Pro
(which costs $47.99),
Core
, and
Education
.

data.title: The Lost Towers of the Guelph-Ghibelline Wars
data.author: wallflower
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了中世纪意大利城市中大量存在的塔楼，特别是在博洛尼亚和佛罗伦萨。这些塔楼由富裕家族建造，作为防御工事和身份象征，同时具备防火功能。然而，这些塔楼也带来了城市火灾隐患。佛罗伦萨最终通过法令限制私人建筑高度，许多塔楼因此被削顶，留下如今的石质残段。只有公共建筑如钟楼和政府建筑被允许超过规定高度，形成了佛罗伦萨独特的城市天际线。文章还提到，这些塔楼遗迹反映了中世纪吉uel夫派和吉伯林派战争时期家族间的争斗及其对城市的影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于博洛尼亚中世纪塔楼的不同观点和讨论，包括历史事实、功能、建造原因及相关联想，以及对文章可信度的质疑。

不同观点：
• **Toyg** 指出博洛尼亚不仅仅有两座塔，实际上还有更多塔楼存在，总共有22座，其中7座保持了原始高度。他们提供了一个博洛尼亚欢迎网站的链接来支持这一事实。

• **Libraryofbabel** 提到该博客由历史学家Ada Palmer撰写，她同时也是一位成功的科幻小说作家，并对其在繁忙的教授工作之余还能撰写博客表示惊讶。

• **Internet_points** 对文章中提到的塔楼消失的原因感兴趣，认为是中世纪社会为了共同利益而协同努力的结果，并指出中世纪社会能够为了共同利益而合作。

• **DeathArrow** 质疑为什么当时的富人家庭选择建造高塔而不是更容易防御的其他结构，并猜测这可能与展示财富和地位有关，类似于现代的摩天大楼。

• **DrSiemer** 对文章中第一张图片中塔楼高度的历史数据提出质疑，认为其中可能包含艺术加工。

• **Intrasight** 分享了他们的旅行经历，并补充了Lucca的中世纪塔楼也可以攀登的信息。

• **ErigmolCt** 提到他们之前不知道意大利城市街区中的那些粗糙石块其实是中世纪塔楼的残骸。

• **Trhway** 联想到也门的古老塔楼和格鲁吉亚的塔楼房屋，并提供了相关的维基百科链接。

• **YeGoblynQueenne** 提到视觉上的摩尔效应问题，但未深入讨论。

• **Lucidguppy** 好奇是否有类似于文章中描述的D&D（龙与地下城）设定。

• **Gostsamo** 赞扬文章图片的alt文本描述得很好。

43452588.article_content:
Looks fake, doesn’t it?  This implausible Medieval forest of towers, as dense as Manhattan skyscrapers, is our best reconstruction of the town of Bologna at its height, toward the end of the Medieval Guelph-Ghibelline wars. We don’t see many such towers today… or think we don’t, but actually their remnants are all over Italy.
Often when in Florence one sees buildings like this, where one section is rough stone standing out amid stucco neighbors.
These are actually the bottom nubs of Medieval stone towers. The town of San Gimigniano (below) is famous for having several still intact. Wealthy families built these as mini-fortresses within the city, where they could defend against riots, enemy families (think Montagues and Capulets) and invasion:
Signs of wealth and prestige, these all-stone buildings were also fireproof, leading to a terrible but effective tactic: take your family, treasures & goods up into your tower then set fire to enemies’ homes and let the city burn around you while you sit safe above. This was VERY BAD for cities.
street corner in San Gimigniano
After many disasters, Florence’s solution was to BAN private buildings over a certain height, forcing everyone who had a tower to knock the top off down to regulation height, leaving these recognizable stone nubs all around the city. This round one below is the oldest (now a restaurant).
My favorite tower stub is this one, in Via dei Cerchi. I lived on the top floor for a year as a grad student, up 111 steps! I had calves of steel by spring, but the views from the top looked like someone had put a poster of Florence on the wall except it was a window!
Only city buildings were allowed to exceed the mandated height, which is why Florence’s skyline is now all special buildings: monastery bell towers, the cathedral & baptistery, Orsanmichele the city’s granary (tall to keep grain away from water & mice), the seat of government, and one special guy…
The tower on the right here is part of Bargello, the prison & police fortress, but it didn’t start that way. It was built by a private family, who sold it to the city when the law banning towers was passed, and the city incorporated it into their prison fort.
The city jail had to be a fortress in case someone from a powerful family was arrested and the family sent goons to break them out (those guys who bite their thumbs in the opening scene of Romeo & Juliet would *totally* have stormed the jail to bust Romeo out!).
In this photo you can see how the brick battlements are a later addition, added to the tower as part of its transformation from private fortress to public.
What did Florence look like back when it had all its towers? Its long-time ally across the mountains Bologna is famous for still having two intact towers, but in the Middle Ages Bologna was known as the City of 100 Towers because so many families built them. The reconstructions look absolutely incredible. Florence didn’t have so many but did have dozens, so the richest part of the city center would have looked much like this.  Much to the despair of the city fire brigade!
So, whether in a film or on the street, if you ever see a historic Italian city and walk along a block where for some reason one chunk of wall is stone and all the others smooth, you’re probably looking at a relic of the faction feuds that Guido Ruggiero aptly calls “The Italian 300 Years’ War.”
I talk about this long war in
“Inventing the Renaissance,”
one of many points of continuity which show how the supposed difference between a bad “Dark Ages” and Renaissance “golden age” is 100% propaganda, but fascinating propaganda with a deep history.
And I’ll share more tidbits like over the coming days as we countdown to the book’s release!

data.title: DJ With Apple Music launches to enable subscribers to mix their own sets
data.author: CharlesW
data.article_summary: Apple推出了“DJ with Apple Music”功能，允许Apple Music订阅用户直接从其超过1亿首歌曲的库中挑选和混音。该功能与AlphaTheta、Serato、Engine DJ、Denon DJ、Numark和Rane DJ等主流DJ软件和硬件平台集成，并扩展了与Algoriddim的Djay Pro软件的整合。DJ们可以在这些平台上访问和创作混音，并利用新的DJ专用页面和编辑推荐的播放列表。Apple Music承诺支持DJ社群，通过这一集成，DJ们可以更轻松地实时访问、播放和发现音乐。这一创新旨在提升DJ的创作体验，使DJing变得更加便捷和普及。各大DJ软件和硬件公司的高管均表示对此次合作的期待与兴奋。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：DJ软件和硬件的集成、功能、音质以及与Apple Music的整合

不同观点：
• sowbug：对Apple产品不感兴趣，但通过DJ Studio（一个帮助制作离线混音的桌面应用）享受了这个领域。欣赏该团队的专业和热情，认为该产品很好地填补了一个细分市场。
• lvl155：作为一个业余爱好者，长期使用RME接口上的loop back功能，虽然有些麻烦。
• easyThrowaway：测试了Apple Music与rekordbox的整合，觉得音质可能为256kbps/aac，存在一些失真问题，且没有离线存储选项。
• ahilss：Transitions DJ的开发者，对与Apple Music整合感兴趣，寻求引荐。
• Gigachad：认为该功能对需要在网络不稳定场所使用USB的职业DJ不太实用，但对于不需要额外订阅的普通家庭用户有吸引力。
• kcrwfrd_：询问是否支持rekordbox，并希望能在Pioneer XDJ设备上使用Apple Music。
• shreyshnaccount：希望能够简单地在播放列表中拼接歌曲。
• kakoni：推荐使用ddj-flx4控制器和iPhone组合，搭配rekordbox和Apple Music，打造不错的卧室/便携设置。
• a2dam：提到Spotify曾有类似功能但已下架，对此表示不满。
• sollewitt：指出Djay的算法分离功能是其杀手锏，但Apple Music的整合不支持此功能，可能是授权协议的限制。
• nanna：提到现代DJ通过按按钮即可混音，失去了过去手动混音和节拍匹配的技能自豪感。
• faangguyindia：描述了在不同场景下使用不同设备和音乐源的习惯。
• cedws：作为入门级用户，对DJing感兴趣，认为这个功能对他有帮助，因为一般只从Bandcamp购买音乐。
• plasma_beam：关心是否能访问自己同步到Apple Music的图书馆和播放列表，而不是Apple Music库。
• pacifika：提到Tidal也有类似功能。

补充讨论：
• 音质和失真问题是部分用户关注的焦点，尤其是与 lossless 版本对比时。
• 是否支持离线存储和访问个人图书馆也是用户关心的功能点。
• 用户对不同平台（如Spotify和Tidal）类似功能的体验和比较也是讨论的一个重要方面。
• 现代DJ技术和传统技能之间的对比引发了一些用户的感慨。
• 对入门用户和职业DJ的不同需求存在明显分歧，主要集中在功能可靠性和使用场景上。

43489271.article_content:
Apple has introduced DJ with Apple Music, which enables
Apple Music
subscribers to build and mix sets directly from the streaming services catalogue.
The feature is integrated with DJ software and hardware platforms AlphaTheta, Serato and InMusic’s Engine DJ, Denon DJ, Numark, and Rane DJ. It builds on an integration with Algoriddim's Djay Pro software.
DJs at all levels will have access to Apple Music’s catalogue of more than 100 million songs to create and rehearse their sets on any of these DJ software and hardware platforms
“Apple Music is committed to supporting DJs,” said
Stephen Campbell, global head of dance, electronic & DJ mixes at Apple Music
. “With this latest integration, we’re taking that commitment even further – seamlessly connecting Apple Music with the industry’s leading DJ software and hardware. This innovation brings the full power of Apple Music into the creative workflow, making it easier than ever for DJs to access, play, and discover music in real time.”
Users can also access a new dedicated DJ with Apple Music category page, spotlighting a series of DJ-friendly editorial playlists, along with new curator pages for each DJ software and hardware platform that will showcase any mixes or sample playlists that can be used to practice.
"The integration of Djay with Apple Music across mobile, desktop, and spatial devices opens up a world of creative possibilities for both beginners and seasoned pros,” said Karim Morsy, CEO at Algoriddim. “With instant access to Apple Music’s catalogue of over 100 million songs,
DJs can mix anytime
, anywhere – transforming the way they discover and play their favorite music. Whether using Automix for a seamless, hands-free experience or crafting their own unique sets with djay’s powerful mixing tools, this integration marks a major milestone in making DJing more accessible than ever.”
Apple Music is committed to supporting DJs
Stephen Campbell
“We are thrilled to bring this integration with Apple Music to DJs around the world and in their creative process," said Yoshinori Kataoka, president and CEO of AlphaTheta. "This marks a significant step forward in making DJing more accessible, and we couldn’t be more excited about the possibilities it opens up.”
"At inMusic, our goal has always been to empower DJs with innovative tools that enhance creativity and performance,” said Morgan Donoghue, VP marketing, DJ brands at InMusic. “Integrating Apple Music into our Engine DJ platforms marks a major step forward, giving DJs instant access to a vast library of over 100 million tracks and expertly curated playlists to build and refine their sets with ease. This collaboration ensures DJs at every level can seamlessly discover, play, and integrate new music into their creative workflow."
“Teaming up with Apple Music is a milestone moment for Serato’s artist community,” said Young Ly, CEO at Serato. “We are excited to see established and new DJs alike combine their passion and creativity with access to one of the largest streaming catalogues in the world.”
DJ with Apple Music builds upon
Apple Music’s DJ Mixes
, a programme that launched on the platform in September 2021 with a collection of thousands of sets.
In December, Apple Music also launched Apple Music Club, a live global radio station with curated DJ mixes.
“Today’s launch aims to expand on that relationship by encouraging DJs to use this integrated experience as a creative tool, allowing them to access and find inspiration in their libraries more easily,” concluded the statement.

data.title: First C compiler source code from 1972
data.author: cft
data.article_summary: 这篇文章列出了一个代码仓库中的文件目录，包含多个C语言源文件（如c00.c、c01.c等）和一些汇编文件（如c0t.s、cctab.s等）。这些文件可能属于一个名为"legacy-cc"的项目，涉及编译器或相关工具的开发。用户可以查看所有文件，进行分支（fork）和标记（star）操作，但需要登录才能更改通知设置。文章内容主要描述了目录结构和文件列表。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：早期C语言编译器的历史、技术细节及其新闻价值

不同观点：
• [ytch] 认为该话题是重复的，并提供了一个之前讨论的链接（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=43433030），表明这个内容之前已经被讨论过。

• [cpr] 分享了一段关于早期C语言的历史记忆，提到在1973年左右在哈佛大学看到了C编译器的源代码，并对该语言产生了浓厚兴趣。他还提到哈佛大学在贝尔实验室之外第一个获得了Unix磁带，并指出当时使用的设备（DEC行式打印机）仅支持大写字母。

• [zahlman] 对现代编译器（如gcc）能否编译早期C代码提出疑问，特别关注是否因为包含PDP-11汇编代码而无法编译，还是因为C语言本身发生了变化。

• [qq66] 提出了一个技术性问题，询问第一个C编译器是如何用C语言编写的，暗示对自举过程（bootstrapping）或早期编译器实现方式的兴趣。

• [webprofusion] 认为这个话题已经不再具有新闻价值，指出自2013年以来已经被提交到Hacker News（HN）讨论了9次。

补充讨论：
• [cpr] 的评论提供了关于早期计算机硬件和软件环境的细节，如DEC行式打印机不支持小写字母，以及哈佛大学与Unix的早期联系，这为理解早期C语言编译器的历史背景提供了重要背景信息。

• [zahlman] 和 [qq66] 的评论引发了对技术实现细节的讨论，包括早期C代码的可编译性和自举问题，这些都是计算机科学历史上重要且有趣的技术细节。

争议焦点：

War story: the hardest bug I ever debugged
All of a sudden, without any ostensible cause, Google Docs was flooded with errors. How it took me 2 days and a coworker to solve the hardest bug I ever debugged.
Jacob Voytko
Mar 24, 2025
Share this post

Copy link

More
Share
When I was on the Google Docs team, we did a weekly bug triage where we’d look for new issues and randomly assign them to teammates to investigate. One week, we had a new top error by a wide margin.
It was a fatal error. This means that it prevented the user from editing without reloading. It didn’t correspond to a Google Docs release. The stack trace added very little information. There wasn’t an associated spike in user complaints, so we weren’t even sure it was really happening — but if it
was
happening it would be really bad. It was Chrome-only starting at a specific release. This is less helpful than it sounds, since we often wrote browser-specific Docs bugs that affected only one of Internet Explorer, Firefox, Safari, and Chrome.
I tried to repro in dev. This was important for 2 reasons:
Rule out Closure Compiler, Docs’ JavaScript compiler at the time.
Debugging in unoptimized code is always easier than the alternative.
Okay, how do I begin? I crawled through our logs for internal users who had suffered from the problem. I hoped that somebody could tell me, “oh yeah, every time I try to do $foo it breaks.” But no internal users had been affected. Back to the drawing board.
I did a bunch of wild edits for a while. I added as many esoteric features as I could, copy/pasted a bunch of stuff into Docs from news websites to try to trigger the issue, played around with tables for a while. No dice.
What next? At the time, Docs had a basic scripting tool that could perform repetative actions. It was mostly useful for performance benchmarking, but because it provided consistent behavior I tried it out. I made a 50-page doc filled with
lorem ipsum
and had the script bold and unbold the entire document 100 times. Somewhere around the 20th cycle it crashed. I checked my console and it was the error in question!
I do it a few more times. It’s not always the 20th iteration, but it usually happens sometime between the 10th and 40th iteration. Sometimes it never happend. Okay, the bug is nondeterministic. We’re off to a bad start.
I think about the repro case. Is there anything interesting about bolding and unbolding large bodies of text? Yes actually. In many fonts and for many text samples, bolded text is wider than unbolded text. This was true for the font I was using. So it could have something do with wrapping lots of lines of text.
I set a breakpoint and started investigating. The crash looked like it was caused by some bad bookkeeping in the view, because the actual crash was reading a garbage cache value and trying to operate on it, and crashing as a result.
At the time
1
, Google Docs didn’t produce an HTML page as you might expect. It absolutely positioned every single thing on screen below the menu. To power this, Docs had a full layout engine that ran on every single keystroke. To make this even remotely performant within a browser in the 2010s, everything in the view was cached to within an inch of its life.
What does this mean? The place that crashed was downstream of the error. The error happened. Then there were some operations on the error. Then some accumulators accepted the wrong value. Then they were written to a cache. Eventually, some time later, there were enough bookkeeping errors that it was causing a crash.
If you consider everything together, this is a worst-case scenario. The bug is nondeterministic. What could even be causing that? Subpixel rendering errors that don’t deterministically accumulate? Kill me now. Next, the reproduction was slow. It took probably 20 seconds just to load the dev version of the editor, and another 40 seconds to trigger the issue. Then I needed to examine the state until I found something that was wrong, and then figure out how to set a breakpoint at the moment that wrong thing was cached or added to a queue.
If you haven’t debugged a lot of mystery problems, this is not what you want. Normally, you’d want to debug a mystery problem by binary searching.
Is the problem on the client or the server? Client.
Is the problem in the model or the view? View
Is the problem in the UI rendering or the generic view processing? Generic view processing.
And so on until you find where the bug is happening.
And then you keep halving what could be causing the problem until it’s clearly happening within some component, and then the bug’s days are numbered.
I had something else going against me. Until this point, I had mostly worked in the server, model, and network code. I was far from an expert in the view, which was the most compli

data.title: AI Reveals Secrets of Dendritic Growth in Thin Films
data.author: rustoo
data.article_summary: 研究团队开发了一种可解释的人工智能（AI）模型，用于预测薄膜生长过程中的枝晶结构，帮助优化薄膜生长工艺。枝晶结构在诸如铜、石墨烯等多层薄膜材料的早期生长阶段常见，影响设备性能。为解决这一问题，东京科学大学的Masato Kotsugi教授及其团队结合持久同调（PH）和主成分分析（PCA）等方法，通过分析吉布斯自由能变化，揭示了枝晶分支的机制。该方法提供了新的材料生长机制见解，为优化薄膜制造提供了数据驱动的途径，并可能推动超越5G的高速通信技术发展。研究成果发表于《Science and Technology of Advanced Materials: Methods》期刊。

• [motbus3] 进一步指出，PCA 甚至不能算作人工智能（AI），而只是旧的机器学习（ML）算法，暗示其与当前先进的AI技术有差距。
• [MPSFounder] 表示 PCA 确实是一种较老的 ML 方法，回忆自己上次使用PCA是在15年前的本科论文中，强调其应用的年代久远。

补充讨论：
• 几位评论者都提到PCA的"老旧"性质，暗示其在现代机器学习或人工智能领域中可能不再占据主要地位。
• 争议的焦点在于PCA是否能被视为现代机器学习技术的一部分，以及其在当前AI发展中的相关性和重要性。
• 例子：[MPSFounder] 提到自己在本科论文中使用PCA，进一步支持了该技术已经存在较长时间的观点。

总的来说，评论者普遍认为PCA是一种较老的技术，在现代机器学习和AI中应用较少，但仍有其历史价值。

43463579.article_content:
MEDIA RELATIONS
2025.03.19 Wednesday
Breakthrough in Materials Science: AI Reveals Secrets of Dendritic Growth in Thin Films
Researchers have developed a new AI model that predicts dendritic growth in thin films, helping optimize thin-film growth processes
Thin film devices, composed of layers of materials a few nanometers thick, play an important role in various technologies, from semiconductors to communication technologies. For instance, graphene and hexagonal-boron nitride (h-BN) multilayer thin films, deposited on copper substrates, are promising materials for next-generation high-speed communications systems. Thin films are grown by depositing tiny layers of materials onto a substrate. The growth process conditions significantly influence the microstructure of these films, which in turn influences their function and performance.
Dendritic structures, or tree-like branching patterns that emerge during growth, pose a major challenge to large-area fabrication of thin-film devices, a key step toward commercial application.  They are commonly observed in materials like copper, graphene, and borophene, particularly in the early growth stage and multilayer films. Since the microstructure directly impacts device performance, reducing dendritic formation is, therefore, critical. However, methods for studying dendrites have largely relied on crude visual analysis and subjective interpretation. Understanding the conditions that drive dendritic branching is essential for optimizing the thin-film growth process, but existing approaches often require considerable trial and error.
To address these challenges, a research team, led by Professor Masato Kotsugi from the Department of Material Science and Technology at Tokyo University of Science (TUS), Japan, developed an innovative explainable artificial intelligence (AI) model for analyzing dendritic structures. The team included Misato Tone, also from TUS, and Ippei Obayashi from Okayama University. The team developed a novel method that bridges structure and process in dendritic growth by integrating persistent homology and machine learning with energy analysis.
"Our approach provides new insights into growth mechanisms and offers a powerful, data-driven pathway for optimizing thin-film fabrication,"
explains Prof. Kotsugi. Their study was published online in
Science and Technology of Advanced Materials: Methods
on March 7, 2025.
To analyze the morphology of dendrite structures, the team used a cutting-edge topology method called persistent homology (PH). PH enables multiscale analysis of holes and connections within geometric structures, capturing the complex topological features of the tree-like dendrite microstructures that conventional image processing techniques often overlook.
The researchers combined PH with principal component analysis (PCA), a machine learning technique. Through PCA, the essential features of the dendrite morphology extracted via PH were reduced to a two-dimensional space. This enabled the team to quantify structural changes in dendrites and establish a relationship between these changes and Gibbs free energy, or the energy available in a material that influences how dendrites form during crystal growth. By analyzing this relationship, they uncovered the specific conditions and hidden growth mechanisms that influence dendritic branching. Prof. Kotsugi explains,
"Our framework quantitatively maps dendritic morphology to Gibbs free energy variations, revealing energy gradients that drive branching behavior."
To validate their approach, the researchers studied dendrite growth in a hexagonal copper substrate and compared their results with data from phase-field simulations.
"By integrating topology and free energy, our method offers a versatile approach to material analysis. Through this integration, we can establish a hierarchical connection between atomic-scale microstructures and macroscopic functionalities across a wide range of materials, paving the way for future advancements in material science,"
remarks Prof. Kotsugi.
"Importantly, our method could lead to the development of high-quality thin-film devices leading to high-speed communication beyond 5G."
This study's framework could pave the way for breakthroughs in sensor technology, nonequilibrium physics, and high-performance materials by uncovering hidden structure-function relationships and advancing complex system analysis.
